sections.overall: With two 8+ rated matches against Kevin Knight and PAC on Dynamite and Fairway to Hell respectively, Darby Allin has reached #1 for the first time in his career! As has been the case since winning the Men's World Title, Darby has featured in the best AEW match this week. How long can he continue this for?!
sections.mens: Other than the Darby title matches, there were no other standout ones this week. Jon Moxley slips several points due to his below-expectations Eliminator match against Juice Robinson. Still, his overall rating of just under 140 is a very strong one. The (unexpected?) National Title title change between Mark Davis and Jack Perry resulted in a small ratings gain for both.
sections.womens: The only singles match in the Women's division (Jamie Hayter vs Skye Blue) led to small points gain for both this week. However, as there are so few opportunities for the female wrestlers in AEW to showcase what they can do, this relatively meant an impressive climb: up from #10 to #6. Also, this was Skye's best match so far of 2026! WIll we see a sustained singles push for her in the near future?
sections.menstag: No individual men's tag matches this week, though three (The Young Bucks, The Gunns - welcome back - and The Dogs (Connors & Finlay) did all feature within the 10 Man Tag match on Collision.
sections.womenstag: Divine Dominion's squash match on Fairway to Hell was not eligible for the ratings (being under five minutes) so their momentum is halted, for now. With Sisters Of Sin dropping out after 6 weeks of inactivity, instead the #1 spot goes to Shida & Statlander. This new team only have 2 counting matches, but with both rated over 6, their consistency so far has been rewarded.
sections.trios: Again, no straight Trios matches this week, the only teams being within a 10 Man Tag. No major changes to the acts involved (represented by the Bang Bang Gang and Death Riders). This means The Demand continue their reign at the top. With Double or Nothing coming up and this Trio confirmed in Stadium Stampede, this could be a big gain coming up for these three wrestlers.
